David hopes to visit Rome one day. Life is full of small surprises. The river bank is one of the best places in the city. The ant carried a crumb bigger than itself.
Eva is interested in cooking. David learned a lot about music. There are always many people at the flower market. My uncle, a heavy smoker, is trying hard to quit.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the river bank by bike. Eva's birthday is in August. David wrote about the day in the diary. The sky is cloudy this morning.
The weather was cloudy that day. David likes cloudy days best. David bought a T-shirt at the shop yesterday.
